title: Lavender Paper Towel Holder - 15.5-Inch Wall Mount Powder Coated Iron Pipe Style, Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Free up countertop space and keep paper towels right where you need them—this wall-mounted holder is protected with a highly durable powder coat and backed by a limited lifetime warranty in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat.

  • Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Maintains a clean, decorative finish with powder coated iron pipe construction
  • Resists corrosion and rust for dependable everyday use
  • Pairs easily with matching pipeline, pipe-style accessories from the Pipeline collection

Why it lasts: Powder coated iron and a durable finish provide corrosion-free, rust-free performance for continual service.

Specs

  • Product type: Wall mounted paper towel holder
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 in x 3 in x 4 in
  • Projection: 4 in
  • Material: Iron
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Weight capacity: 250 lb
  • Included: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware; color coordinated mounting hardware; screw size #8 X1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your kitchen with coordinating pieces from the Pipeline collection.
